# Flow allocation (WSIMOD): catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Rule-based allocation of water between stores on capacity-limited arcs. How the pieces fit together: [Flow allocation (WSIMOD)](../applications/allocation.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Using noodl](../usage.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.wsimod`. The full reference, with every parameter, is in the [API reference](../api.md).

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `build_model` | `(model, state, drivers)` for a WSIMOD topology (a mapping, or a JSON file path). | `build_model(topology, *, storage_max=None, kind='link', layer_name='wsimod', mode='hard', tau=None, preference=None, initial_storage=None)` |
| `initial_drivers` | Zero requests (`build_model`'s driver template), then `values` by arc name: `initial_drivers(model, values={"wsimod.requests": {"baseflow": 0.3}})`. | `initial_drivers(model, *, values=None)` |
| `initial_state` | Empty stores, `"<layer>.s" = 0` for every allocation layer, then `values`. | `initial_state(model, *, values=None)` |
